title: The Stall With No Name
subtitle: An alias, so a rename does not orphan progress
description: `aliases` lists a quest's former ids. An id appears in player progress files, so a rename without an alias orphans the completions stored under the old one — the player keeps the memory and the quest does not. The alias is the fix, and it resolves everywhere the id does.
The glazier beside this quest is the proof: its `dependsOn` names `the_nameless_stall`, the alias, and the dependency resolves.
